_note: One energy model (docs/design/power-scale.md, Game Design; sim/core/power.gd). Off until Orb's build. Simulation and the director read level, energy, speedUnit, share, flight and launchTravel; World and VFX read the rest as they're built.
_speedUnit: a launch's speed is this x the root of energy x share
_popForce: a launch beat at or under this force is a style's small pop: stylePop
_share: Combat's shares for every launching move (docs/combat/pending/power-shares)

share._launcher: a lit launcher, Game Design on the first reach read. It was 0.25
share._tap: a tap of B: a stagger (docs/design/press-decides.md). It sends nobody, so it sets no speed: for what it does to what it hits
share._firstFlash: B past the first flash: a knock-back. Its length stays as ruled, so it sets no speed either
share._unlisted: a launch beat of a template with no row

launchAnywhere._about: By its existing power. 0.5 only for a full string on a sure, perfect link

kits._about: One row for all four fighters. The yank and the bind send nobody, and the stick never sends, so none of them has a share.

kitFields._about: Not shares: the two places a fighter's kit differs, both already in its design.

_flight: flat out, plain stance: flatOut x growth^level. min and max hold a setup's flatOut, the page's slider
_travel: a setup's "travel" (the page's ?travel= slider, for Orb's hands) tries another launchTravel, held to min and max. Game Design's lever is 1.5, then 1.25 (slam-and-pace.md section 2)
_meteorSpeed: the meteor and the high arc are authored curves. They count as this for their crater, buildings and energy, and their trail burns in full for the whole curve (power-scale.md)
